commands.provision: py -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; py -m pip install jsonschema pyyaml pytest
commands.clean: Remove-Item sample-manifest.csv, evidence-verdicts.json, audit-test-sheet.csv, nonconformity-register.csv, evidence-index.csv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

public_tests.report: tests/ (pytest -q console output; no separate report file generated)

manual_preconditions: jsonschema, pyyaml, and pytest must be installed via 'py -m pip install' (not plain 'pip install') to avoid multiple-Python PATH mismatches on Windows.
known_limitations: Published per-population sample sizes were not issued; a disclosed placeholder (99) is used instead. See README.md.
normalize_timestamp() does not handle 'Z'-suffixed timestamps on Python 3.10; sample-manifest.csv's event_time_utc column is not a true UTC conversion for affected rows. See README.md.
